## Tips & gotchas

- Standard antennas require a 'ground plane'—a horizontal surface to reflect signals—and an electrical ground. [t2332]
- 'No Ground Plane' antennas are designed for situations where mounting on metal is difficult, such as fiberglass bodies or side-mounted positions. [t2332]
